The intent here is vague, since "windswept" is really more of a mood than a concrete search term, so I'm weighing whether the keyword search approach was reasonable. The assistant found one result and stopped there, but I'm questioning whether a 0.92 confidence is justified given the overview doesn't clearly connect to that windswept feel.

Given the weak grounding, this likely warrants rejection since the confidence seems inflated relative to how loosely the result actually matches the requested mood.
